name: rds_cluster
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS RDS (Aurora) cluster.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this RDS cluster.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the RDS cluster.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this cluster to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (under an environment) this cluster belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: engine
attributes.description: Database engine (e.g. aurora-postgresql, aurora-mysql).

attributes.name: engine_version
attributes.description: Engine version. Changing this in place triggers an engine upgrade.

attributes.name: engine_mode
attributes.description: Cluster engine mode. Accepted values are defined by the backend RdsClusterEngineMode enum (e.g. the provisioned vs. serverless mode); confirm the exact value against your tenant.

attributes.name: db_name
attributes.description: Name of the initial database created in the cluster.

attributes.name: master_username
attributes.description: Master (admin) username. Required when creating a new cluster (not restoring from a snapshot).

attributes.name: master_user_password
attributes.description: Master user password. Omit when manage_master_user_password is true.

attributes.name: manage_master_user_password
attributes.description: Let AWS manage the master user password in Secrets Manager instead of supplying master_user_password.

attributes.name: snapshot_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of a snapshot to restore the cluster from.

attributes.name: visibility
attributes.description: Network visibility of the cluster. Accepted values are defined by the backend RdsVisibility enum (e.g. private vs. public); confirm the exact value against your tenant.

attributes.name: db_subnet_group_name
attributes.description: DB subnet group the cluster is placed in.

attributes.name: vpc_security_group_ids
attributes.description: VPC security group IDs attached to the cluster.

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Cluster storage type (e.g. aurora, aurora-iopt1).

attributes.name: storage_encrypted
attributes.description: Storage encryption mode. Accepted values are defined by the backend RdsStorageEncryptionMode enum; confirm the exact value against your tenant.

attributes.name: kms_key_id
attributes.description: KMS key ID used for storage encryption.

attributes.name: backup_retention_period
attributes.description: Number of days automated backups are retained.

attributes.name: preferred_backup_window
attributes.description: Daily time range (UTC) for automated backups, e.g. 07:00-09:00.

attributes.name: preferred_maintenance_window
attributes.description: Weekly time range (UTC) for maintenance, e.g. sun:05:00-sun:06:00.

attributes.name: copy_tags_to_snapshot
attributes.description: Copy cluster tags to snapshots.

attributes.name: deletion_protection
attributes.description: Enable deletion protection on the cluster.

attributes.name: auto_minor_version_upgrade
attributes.description: Automatically apply minor engine version upgrades.

attributes.name: enable_iam_database_authentication
attributes.description: Enable IAM database authentication.

attributes.name: enable_http_endpoint
attributes.description: Enable the Data API (HTTP endpoint) for the cluster.

attributes.name: enable_performance_insights
attributes.description: Enable Performance Insights.

attributes.name: database_insights_mode
attributes.description: Database Insights mode (e.g. standard, advanced).

attributes.name: enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports
attributes.description: Log types to export to CloudWatch (e.g. postgresql, audit, error).

attributes.name: backtrack_window
attributes.description: Target backtrack window in seconds (Aurora MySQL only). 0 disables backtracking.

attributes.name: ca_certificate_identifier
attributes.description: CA certificate identifier for the cluster.

attributes.name: serverless_v2_scaling
attributes.description: Aurora Serverless v2 capacity range, in ACUs.

attributes.name: min_capacity
attributes.description: Minimum Aurora capacity units.

attributes.name: max_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum Aurora capacity units.

attributes.name: cluster_parameters
attributes.description: Cluster parameter group overrides.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Parameter name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Parameter value.

attributes.name: cluster_instances
attributes.description: Instances (writer/readers) that make up the cluster.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Instance identifier.

attributes.name: db_instance_class
attributes.description: Instance class (e.g. db.r6g.large, db.serverless).

attributes.name: availability_zone
attributes.description: Availability zone for the instance.

attributes.name: promotion_tier
attributes.description: Failover promotion tier (0-15; lower is promoted first).

attributes.name: ca_certificate_identifier
attributes.description: CA certificate identifier for the instance.

attributes.name: performance_insights_retention_period
attributes.description: Performance Insights retention period in days.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: cluster_endpoint
attributes.description: Writer (primary) endpoint of the provisioned cluster.

attributes.name: reader_endpoint
attributes.description: Reader endpoint of the provisioned cluster.

attributes.name: port
attributes.description: Port the cluster listens on.

attributes.name: master_user_secret_arn
attributes.description: Secrets Manager ARN holding the master credentials (when manage_master_user_password is enabled).

attributes.name: stack_id
attributes.description: ID of the underlying provisioning stack.
